dialect_guard.postgresql: Uses QueuePool sizing, overflow, recycle, pre-ping, and statement_timeout.
dialect_guard.non_postgresql: Keeps pool_pre_ping and pool_recycle while avoiding PostgreSQL-only pool sizing and statement_timeout options.

session_lifecycle_controls: ManagedSession.close() rolls back any open top-level or nested transaction before releasing the connection.
get_db() rolls back on request exceptions and always closes the session in finally.
SessionLocal uses close_resets_only=false so a closed session cannot be reused across request boundaries.
idle_in_transaction_controls: Open transactions left by read-only requests are rolled back during dependency finalization.
Open transactions left by direct SessionLocal context managers are rolled back during context manager exit.
Closed sessions are final, preventing accidental cross-request session reuse.

verification.observed: Closed ManagedSession rejects reuse with InvalidRequestError.
